title: France's organic sector in crisis: Is the end in sight? • FRANCE 24 English
summary: France 24 report on France's shrinking organic farmland as inflation, falling prices and weak state support squeeze organic farmers.

assertions.quote: in just two years, if you see that, that's gone down to 10.1%

verdicts.note: French Agence Bio data show certified organic area fell from 2022 to 2024 as some farms deconverted.

assertions.quote: organic farmers become more vulnerable to price shocks because they don't have uh always have access to the same state aid

verdicts.note: Organic premiums collapsed with inflation in 2022-23, though organic farms also receive specific EU subsidies.

assertions.quote: there are people who just don't have the money to buy organic food
